title: A sell-off meets an ICE BID, and every return to it is turned away
premise: Watch the lower wicks where the selling stops. Two heavy test bars are turned away at one price, the tool confirms an ICE BID there, and each time price comes back the bar closes up off it.

chapters.title: ICE BID
chapters.text: 2 lower-wick test bars on at least average volume within half an ATR, 2 closed rejected. No footprint volume in the band yet, so the bar engine alone confirms 26,509.50.

chapters.title: TESTING
chapters.text: Back at 26,509.50: a long lower wick on 1.4× average volume, closed up, a rejection. Test 3×.

chapters.title: TESTING
chapters.text: Back at 26,509.50: a long lower wick on 1.8× average volume, closed up, a rejection. Test 4×.
